feature: Cloudflare Turnstile captcha untuk pencarian Vehicle Number dan Notice Number
note: UI mewajibkan captcha Turnstile sebelum tombol Search Fines aktif di tab 2 dan 3, dan ada endpoint validasi token. Anotasi @RequireTurnstile tidak dipakai di controller mana pun, jadi /v1/parkingfines tidak memeriksa captcha di backend. Tidak ada story di OCMS50.1-50.5 untuk captcha; belum dicek terhadap story epic lain.
note_en: The UI requires a Turnstile captcha before the Search Fines button is enabled on tabs 2 and 3, and a token validation endpoint exists. The @RequireTurnstile annotation is not used on any controller, so /v1/parkingfines does not check the captcha in the backend. No story in OCMS50.1-50.5 covers the captcha; not checked against stories of other epics.

feature: Tab Paid dan unduh receipt untuk pencarian lewat login (record dibayar 6 bulan terakhir)
note: Setelah login, user bisa pindah ke tab Paid, melihat notice berstatus FP dan mengunduh receipt (printslip). Query ID membatasi data paid dengan window 6 bulan (crs_date_of_suspension >= DATEADD(MONTH,-6,GETDATE())). Story OCMS50.1-50.5 hanya menyebut outstanding fines; belum dicek terhadap story epic lain.
note_en: After login the user can switch to the Paid tab, see notices with status FP and download the receipt (printslip). The ID query limits paid data with a 6-month window (crs_date_of_suspension >= DATEADD(MONTH,-6,GETDATE())). Stories OCMS50.1-50.5 only mention outstanding fines; not checked against stories of other epics.

feature: Blokir pembayaran saat transaksi masih diproses (pesan E10 dalam 300 detik, E11 setelah itu)
note: Jika ada transaksi web terakhir berstatus belum sukses dalam 300 detik, notice ditandai tidak bisa dibayar (E10, status Processing Payment); setelah itu E11 dan bisa dicoba lagi. Tidak ada story di OCMS50.1-50.5 untuk aturan ini; mungkin milik story pembayaran lain, belum dicek.
note_en: If the latest web transaction has not succeeded within 300 seconds, the notice is marked not payable (E10, status Processing Payment); after that E11 applies and a retry is allowed. No story in OCMS50.1-50.5 covers this rule; it may belong to another payment story, not checked.

feature: Mode bypass SPCP untuk environment dev
note: Dengan spcp.bypass.enabled=true (hanya di application-dev.properties) login Singpass/Corppass dilewati dan session dibuat dari NRIC di properties. uat/prod tidak mengatur flag ini sehingga default false; nilai di server asli cannot verify from repo. Fitur bantu pengujian, bukan fitur untuk user; tidak perlu diklaim.
note_en: With spcp.bypass.enabled=true (only in application-dev.properties) the Singpass/Corppass login is skipped and the session is created from the NRIC in the properties. uat/prod do not set this flag so it defaults to false; the real server value cannot verify from repo. A testing aid, not a user feature; no need to claim it.
